heading: § 1910.36 Design and construction requirements for exit routes.

results.sourcePhrase: Each exit route must be a permanent part of the workplace.

results.claim: 1910.36(b)(1) at least two exit routes, located as far apart as practical
results.sourcePhrase: At least two exit routes must be available in a workplace
located as far away as practical from each other

results.claim: 1910.36(b)(2) more than two where size/occupancy/arrangement demands
results.sourcePhrase: More than two exit routes must be available in a workplace if the number of employees, the size of the building, its occupancy, or the arrangement of the workplace

results.claim: 1910.36(b)(3) single exit route permitted only where all can evacuate safely
results.sourcePhrase: A single exit route is permitted where the number of employees

results.claim: 1910.36(c)(1) discharge leads directly outside or to street/walkway/refuge/public way/open space
results.sourcePhrase: Each exit discharge must lead directly outside or to a street, walkway, refuge area, public way, or open space with access to the outside.

results.claim: 1910.36(c)(2) discharge area large enough for occupants likely to use it
results.sourcePhrase: must be large enough to accommodate the building occupants likely to use the exit route

results.claim: 1910.36(d)(1) openable from inside without keys, tools, or special knowledge
results.sourcePhrase: Employees must be able to open an exit route door from the inside at all times without keys, tools, or special knowledge.

results.claim: 1910.36(f)(1) capacity supports maximum permitted occupant load
results.sourcePhrase: Exit routes must support the maximum permitted occupant load for each floor served.
The ceiling of an exit route must be at least seven feet six inches
An exit access must be at least 28 inches

results.claim: "free and unobstructed" is NOT a 1910.36 requirement
"No materials or equipment may be placed" is NOT in 1910.36
results.absentPhrase: No materials or equipment may be placed
